title: Yellow Turkish Bulgur Kisir
description: A traditional Turkish dish featuring bulgur, vegetables, and a tangy dressing, served in a cast-iron skillet.
instructions: Rinse the bulgur in a fine mesh sieve and drain well.
In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil, then add the bulgur, cover, and remove from heat.
Let the bulgur sit for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
In a large cast-iron skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped red onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, and paprika, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked bulgur to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the kisir hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or mint, if desired.
